open System
open System.IO
open System.Data
open System.Threading
open System.Threading.Tasks
open Microsoft.Data.SqlClient
open NodaTime
open NodaTime.Text
open Grace.Types.Usage

let connectionString = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(__SOURCE_DIRECTORY__, "connection.txt")).Trim()
let scope: UsageFactScope = { OwnerId = Guid.Parse "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"; OrganizationId = Guid.Parse "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"; RepositoryId = Guid.Parse "33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333" }
let start = InstantPattern.ExtendedIso.Parse("2026-09-07T01:02:03.123456789Z").Value
let finish = InstantPattern.ExtendedIso.Parse("2026-09-07T01:02:03.123456790Z").Value
let row = (scope, 37L, 2L, start, finish)
let mutable identity = 0
let nextId () =
    identity <- identity + 1
    Guid.Parse(sprintf "10560000-0000-0000-0000-%012d" identity)
let reports = ResizeArray<string>()
let check name condition = if not condition then failwith name else reports.Add name
let bind (cmd: SqlCommand) name value = cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue(name, value) |> ignore
let execute text = task {
    use c = new SqlConnection(connectionString)
    do! c.OpenAsync()
    use cmd = new SqlCommand(text,c)
    let! _ = cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync()
    return () }
let read (c:SqlConnection) (tx:SqlTransaction) locked id (ct:CancellationToken) = task {
    use cmd = new SqlCommand("SELECT OwnerId,OrganizationId,RepositoryId,Bytes,Count,Started,Finished FROM dbo.Observation " + (if locked then "WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) " else "") + "WHERE Id=@id",c,tx)
    bind cmd "@id" id
    use! reader = cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync(ct)
    let! exists = reader.ReadAsync(ct)
    return if exists then Some ({OwnerId=reader.GetGuid 0; OrganizationId=reader.GetGuid 1; RepositoryId=reader.GetGuid 2},reader.GetInt64 3,reader.GetInt64 4,InstantPattern.ExtendedIso.Parse(reader.GetString 5).Value,InstantPattern.ExtendedIso.Parse(reader.GetString 6).Value) else None
}
let lookup id ct = task {
    use c = new SqlConnection(connectionString)
    do! c.OpenAsync(ct)
    return! read c null false id ct }
let accept id ((s,b,n,a,z) as candidate) failure (locked:unit->Task) ct = task {
    use c = new SqlConnection(connectionString)
    do! c.OpenAsync(ct)
    use tx = c.BeginTransaction(IsolationLevel.Serializable)
    let! existing = read c tx true id ct
    do! locked()
    let! result = task {
        match existing with
        | Some ((stored,_,_,_,_) as winner) -> return if stored=s then Ok winner else Error "scope conflict"
        | None ->
            if failure="before-write" then failwith failure
            use cmd = new SqlCommand("INSERT dbo.Observation VALUES(@id,@o,@g,@r,@b,@n,@a,@z)",c,tx)
            [("@id",box id);("@o",box s.OwnerId);("@g",box s.OrganizationId);("@r",box s.RepositoryId);("@b",box b);("@n",box n);("@a",box (InstantPattern.ExtendedIso.Format a));("@z",box (InstantPattern.ExtendedIso.Format z))] |> List.iter(fun (k,v)->bind cmd k v)
            let! _ = cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct)
            if failure="precommit" then failwith failure
            let! stored = read c tx false id ct
            return Ok stored.Value
    }
    do! tx.CommitAsync(ct)
    if failure="postcommit" then failwith "discarded acknowledgement"
    return result
}
let capture id s source ct = task {
    let! prior=lookup id ct
    match prior with
    | Some ((stored,_,_,_,_) as value) -> return if stored=s then Ok value else Error "scope conflict"
    | None -> let! candidate=source()
              return! accept id candidate "" (fun()->Task.CompletedTask) ct
}
let noLock ()=Task.CompletedTask
let run () = task {
    do! execute "IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.Observation') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE dbo.Observation; CREATE TABLE dbo.Observation(Id uniqueidentifier PRIMARY KEY,OwnerId uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,OrganizationId uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,RepositoryId uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,Bytes bigint NOT NULL CHECK(Bytes>=0),Count bigint NOT NULL CHECK(Count>=0),Started varchar(40) NOT NULL,Finished varchar(40) NOT NULL)"
    let ct=CancellationToken.None
    let id=nextId()
    let! absent=lookup id ct
    check "initially absent" absent.IsNone
    let! positive=accept id row "" noLock ct
    check "positive exact nine-digit round trip" (positive=Ok row)
    let! independent=lookup id ct
    check "independent stored positive row" (independent=Some row)
    let! retry=capture id scope (fun()->failwith "source must not run") ct
    check "existing lookup skips source" (retry=Ok row)
    let zeroId=nextId()
    let zero=(scope,0L,0L,start,finish)
    let! zeroResult=accept zeroId zero "" noLock ct
    check "known zero persists" (zeroResult=Ok zero)
    let failed=nextId()
    try let! _=capture failed scope (fun()->Task.FromException<_>(Exception "source failed")) ct
        failwith "unexpected success"
    with _ -> ()
    let! residue=lookup failed ct
    check "source failure no row" residue.IsNone
    for failure in ["before-write";"precommit";"postcommit"] do
        let failedId=nextId()
        let mutable threw=false
        try let! _=accept failedId row failure noLock ct
            ()
        with _ -> threw<-true
        check (failure+" injected") threw
        let! stored=lookup failedId ct
        check (failure+" exact residue") (stored=(if failure="postcommit" then Some row else None))
        let! fresh=capture failedId scope (fun()->Task.FromResult row) ct
        check (failure+" fresh connection retry") (fresh=Ok row)
    for changed in [{scope with OwnerId=nextId()};{scope with OrganizationId=nextId()};{scope with RepositoryId=nextId()}] do
        let! conflict=accept id (changed,999L,8L,finish,finish) "" noLock ct
        check "scope collision carries no payload" (conflict=Error "scope conflict")
    let concurrentId=nextId()
    let acquired=TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously)
    let release=TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously)
    let secondStarted=TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously)
    let first=accept concurrentId row "" (fun()->acquired.SetResult();release.Task) ct
    do! acquired.Task
    let second=task { secondStarted.SetResult(); return! accept concurrentId (scope,88L,9L,finish,finish) "" noLock ct }
    do! secondStarted.Task
    release.SetResult()
    let! firstResult=first
    let! secondResult=second
    check "gated different-window first winner" (firstResult=Ok row && secondResult=Ok row)
    let! final=lookup concurrentId ct
    check "independent concurrent row" (final=Some row)
    use cancelled=new CancellationTokenSource()
    cancelled.Cancel()
    let cancelledId=nextId()
    let mutable rejected=false
    try let! _=capture cancelledId scope (fun()->failwith "cancelled source") cancelled.Token
        ()
    with :? OperationCanceledException -> rejected<-true
    check "pre-cancellation rejected" rejected
    let! beforeRetry=lookup cancelledId ct
    check "pre-cancellation no row" beforeRetry.IsNone
    let! afterRetry=capture cancelledId scope (fun()->Task.FromResult row) ct
    check "pre-cancellation fresh retry" (afterRetry=Ok row)
    use audit = new SqlConnection(connectionString)
    do! audit.OpenAsync()
    use query = new SqlCommand("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Observation",audit)
    let! count = query.ExecuteScalarAsync()
    check "independent final exact row count" (unbox<int> count = 7)
    use captureQuery = new SqlCommand("SELECT * FROM dbo.Observation ORDER BY Id FOR JSON PATH",audit)
    use! fragments = captureQuery.ExecuteReaderAsync()
    let rows = Text.StringBuilder()
    while fragments.Read() do rows.Append(fragments.GetString 0) |> ignore
    use parsedRows = Text.Json.JsonDocument.Parse(rows.ToString())
    check "captured complete seven JSON rows" (parsedRows.RootElement.GetArrayLength()=7)
    File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(__SOURCE_DIRECTORY__,"captured-rows.json"),string rows)
    File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(__SOURCE_DIRECTORY__,"results.json"), System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize({| verdict="proven"; controls=reports; start=InstantPattern.ExtendedIso.Format start; finish=InstantPattern.ExtendedIso.Format finish; rows=7; limitations="Failure callbacks and discarded acknowledgement; real SQL transactions and fresh connections; no process kill or network outage." |},System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions(WriteIndented=true)))
    printfn "PROVEN: %d controls; exact UTC nine-digit text; first committed SQL row wins" reports.Count
}
